title: tunnelmind:agent_tools:v1 — AIT constraints
description: Validates the `constraints` object of an ATAP v0.1 AIT declared under the tunnelmind:agent_tools:v1 profile. The canonical-byte serialization of `constraints` MUST NOT exceed 4096 bytes (ATAP v0.1 §6.2).

allowed_tools.description: Tools the agent may call. Absent means no declared allow-list. Capped at 50 identifiers of at most 64 characters to respect the 4 KB constraints ceiling.

max_tool_calls_per_session.description: Most tool calls the agent may make in one session.

identifier.description: A tool name. No spaces or `@`, so it cannot carry a sentence or an email.
